name: Apache — Command Injection Pattern in HTTP Request
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = apache_httpd_raw
| alter url = xdm.network.http.url,
        status = to_integer(xdm.network.http.response_code),
        method = xdm.network.http.method,
        ua = xdm.source.user_agent
| filter url contains "cmd=" and (url contains "wget" or url contains "curl" or url contains "bash" or url contains "/etc/passwd")
       or url contains "exec=" and (url contains "wget" or url contains "curl" or url contains "bash")
       or url contains "shell_exec"
       or url contains "passthru("
       or url contains "system("
       or url contains "..%2f..%2f"
       or url contains "/etc/passwd"
       or url contains "/etc/shadow"
| filter status in (200, 201, 500)
| bin _time span = 30m
| comp count() as hits,
       count_distinct(url) as distinct_payloads,
       values(url) as payload_urls,
       values(method) as methods,
       values(ua) as user_agents,
       values(xdm.target.ipv4) as tgt_ips
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| filter hits >= 2
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, tgt_ips, payload_urls, methods, user_agents
description: Apache request URL containing 'cmd=', 'exec=', 'shell_exec', 'passthru', 'system(', '/etc/passwd', 'wget', or 'curl' — command injection or LFI exploitation attempt.
alert_name: Apache — Command Injection Pattern in HTTP Request
